protocol: PROTOCOL.md § 6 ter (v1.4): written after seeing all the results, before this run

pilot.rule: smallest epochs within 0.5 accuracy points of the best grid cell (mean over the two pilot tasks), then the best learning rate at those epochs

probe.test: 1,000 validation images x 5 presentations, a ~ N(0,1)

manifest.experiment: E2 ter, the soloist that learns the person (protocol section 6 ter, exploratory)

keys.image: index in the CIFAR-10 test set
keys.z_H: person H: plus network, mu = 1, half A (same seeds as E2 and E2 bis)
keys.z_M: log-odds of each machine on its own (not the sum with H), shape (4, N), rows in the order of `machines`; for Mramo z_M0 + z_branch
keys.val_*: the same on validation (val_image: CIFAR-10 training index)

manifest.layout: each image appears 5 times in a row (np.repeat), with independent frames
manifest.machine_training_frame: a ~ N(0, 2), independent of the class

machines.M0: cross-entropy on half B, as M_0 of E2 and E2 bis (same seed)
machines.M0plus: a copy of M0 fine-tuned on half B with cross-entropy: 10 epochs, learning rate the pilot's divided by 5 (0.02), cosine from it to zero, BatchNorm in training mode
machines.Mdue: a copy of M0 fine-tuned as M0plus (same seed, batch order, crops, flips and frames); loss: its cross-entropy plus the binary cross-entropy of the summed log-odds (out1 - out0) + z_H, z_H from frozen H (eval mode, bf16) on the same augmented and framed presentation, no gradient, weight one, no standardisation
machines.Mramo: M0 frozen (eval mode) plus a branch: a new network that sees the framed image with its interior set to zero, trained from scratch with the pilot's epochs, learning rate and one-cycle schedule on the binary cross-entropy of z_H + z_M0 + z_branch (H and M0 frozen, whole framed presentation, no gradient); recorded cue z_M0 + z_branch

manifest.frame: the outer 2-pixel border of all three channels is set to a * delta, in normalised units (after per-channel normalisation), applied after crop and flip, without clipping
manifest.torch_seeds: H and M0 as E2: crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<H|M>') & 0x7fffffff; the fine-tuning of M0plus and Mdue: crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/ter'), shared; the branch of Mramo: crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/ramo'). With cudnn autotuning the runs are not bitwise reproducible: H and M0 are re-trained, close to but not identical with E2's and E2 bis's
manifest.test_and_validation_frames: the same eps as E2: numpy default_rng(crc32('rephase/<task>/s<seed>/<test|val>-a')), a = sqrt(2) * eps

hyperparameters.network: Net of turing-meter experiments/angle-between-errors/gpu/silicon.py with a 2-way head: conv3x3 48-96, maxpool, 96-192, maxpool, 192, global average pool, linear; BatchNorm and ReLU after every convolution
hyperparameters.optimiser: SGD, Nesterov momentum 0.9, weight decay 5e-4, one-cycle schedule (PyTorch OneCycleLR defaults), bf16 autocast
hyperparameters.augmentation: random 32x32 crop of the image reflect-padded by 4 pixels, random horizontal flip

settings.bootstrap_weight: chosen again in each resample on 13 weights
settings.differences: machine minus M0plus, paired on the same resamples; differences_from_M0 likewise from M0

T1.rule: median over units of d_a(Mdue) / d_a(M0plus) >= 0.9, and the slope of Mdue's cue on a opposite in sign to H's in every unit (point estimates)

T2 Mdue.rule: phi(H, Mdue) - phi(H, M0plus) with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

T2 Mramo.rule: phi(H, Mramo) - phi(H, M0plus) with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

T3 Mdue.rule: d_a of the tuned pair (H, Mdue) minus that of (H, M0plus), with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

T3 Mramo.rule: d_a of the tuned pair (H, Mramo) minus that of (H, M0plus), with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5

T4.rule: for Mdue and for Mramo, median tuned turing / Tu_app from k and phi in [0.9, 1.1] (Tu_app: maximum over w >= 0); both must hold

T5.rule: d_a of the tuned pair (H, Mdue) minus d_a of M0plus alone, with its interval above zero in every seed, in >= 3 tasks of 5 (Mramo reported, not judged)
